```{r assemblies}

read_len <- species_full <- tribble(
  ~Taxon,      ~Chromosome,       ~Length,
  "mandarina",           "Z",    180671855,
  "mandarina",      "masked",    337437981,
  "mandarina",         "u50",    244629438,
  "mori",                "Z",    658921778,
  "mori",           "masked",    212446524,
  "mori",              "u50",    212104118,
)


```

## Figure 7

```{r landscapes}

div <- read_delim ("./Input_files/Reads_landscape.tsv") %>%
  mutate (Chromosome = fct_relevel(as.factor(Chromosome), "Z", "u50", "masked")) %>%
  mutate(Group=fct_relevel(as.factor(Group) , "Satellite",  "Helitron" , "DNA", "SINE",  "LINE", "Penelope","LTR" ,  "Unknown"))

div <- div %>%
  merge(read_len, by = c("Taxon", "Chromosome")) %>%
  mutate(Proportion= bp *100/Length)

# div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
#   geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, size = 0.1) + 
#   facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
#   ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura substitution level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
#   theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))

mori <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mori") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  xlim (0,60)

# div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
#   geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, size = 0.1) + 
#   facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
#   ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
#   theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
#   scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
#   theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic"))

mandarina <- div %>% filter(Taxon == "mandarina") %>% ggplot(aes(weight=Proportion)) +
  geom_histogram (aes(x=Div, fill=Group), color="white", binwidth = 1, linewidth = 0.1) + 
  facet_grid(Chromosome ~ Taxon, scales = "free_y") + 
  ylab("Chromsome % ") + xlab ("Kimura Substitution Level") + theme_cowplot(12) + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual (values = Repeat_colors) +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(face="italic")) +
  xlim (0,60)

print(mori)
print(mandarina)


```

```{r upset_plots}
repeats <- read_tsv("./Input_files/Reads_repeats.tsv")

upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "Z") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

z_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "Z Reads Set", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))))

upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "u50") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

u50_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "u50 Reads Set", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))
    ))

upset_df <- repeats %>% filter(Chromosome == "masked") %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "Repeat", values_from = "absLen", names_from = "Taxon", values_fill = 0)

masked_upset <- upset(upset_df, intersect = c("mandarina", "mori"), name = "Masked Reads Set", set_sizes=(
        upset_set_size()
        + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90))
    ))


```

fig7 <- ggdraw( xlim = c(0, 180), ylim = c(0, 220))+
  draw_plot (mori, x=0,y=108, width = 88,height = 112) +
  draw_plot (mandarina, x=0,y=5, width = 88,height = 98) +
  draw_plot (z_upset, x=92,y=150, width = 88,height = 70) +
  draw_plot (u50_upset, x=92,y=75, width = 88,height = 70) +
  draw_plot (masked_upset, x=92,y=0, width = 88,height = 70) +
  draw_label("A", x = 4, y = 216, fontface = 'bold', size = 12) +
  draw_label("B", x = 94, y = 216, fontface = 'bold', size = 12) +
  draw_label("C", x = 94, y = 146, fontface = 'bold', size = 12) +
  draw_label("D", x = 94, y = 71, fontface = 'bold', size = 12) +
  draw_line(x = c(90, 180), y = c(150, 150), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    draw_line(x = c(90, 180), y = c(74, 74), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  draw_line(x = c(90, 90), y = c(0, 220), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4)

plot(fig7)
